name: parovac-platieb
description: Párovač platieb: výpis z banky proti faktúram. Free, client-side tool that matches a camt.053 bank statement (Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB, ČSOB) against a list of issued invoices (Pohoda, Omega, Money S3, SuperFaktúra, iDoklad, Fakturoid, or a plain spreadsheet).
author: ARLing s. r. o. <andrej@arling.sk>
